CustomField.description: Plain Text field kept in sync with Lead_Created_Quarter_No__c's value by the Lead_Sync_Created_Quarter flow. Exists because that formula field is flagged non-groupable/non-filterable-by-set by the platform; this field lets the Pro-Active Pipeline dashboard's Quarter filter match on the exact same fiscal-quarter value (Q1=Apr-Jun ... Q4=Jan-Mar) without that restriction.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically kept in sync with Lead Created Quarter No. by the Lead_Sync_Created_Quarter flow, for dashboard use.
CustomField.label: Lead Created Quarter Dashboard
